tool.name: list_running_services
tool.description: List all currently running systemd services, optionally filtered by name.

when_to_use.trigger: User asks what services are running
User wants to see all active daemons
User asks to find services matching a pattern
System overview or audit of running services

parameters.param: Optional filter to match service names. Example: 'docker' finds docker-related services. Leave empty to list all running services.

safety_rules.rule: This is a read-only tool - always safe to execute
Output limited to 30 services to avoid overwhelming response

example.input: Are there any database services running?

tool.output_format: { count, services: [{ name, load, active, sub }] }
